title: Synthetic PT Progress Narrative Assessment
source: Research fixture, not a payer coverage policy
narrative: Additional PT documentation is sufficient when a recent re-evaluation explicitly records measurable improvement toward a functional goal and an ongoing unmet goal. A procedure code, attendance, or a recommendation alone is insufficient. Conflicting or ambiguous accounts require review.

requirements.description: Recent re-evaluation explicitly documents measurable improvement toward a functional goal and an ongoing unmet goal. Attendance, a procedure code, and a recommendation alone do not demonstrate progress. Conflicting or ambiguous accounts require clinical review.
